title: External code lists
description: The code lists other standards keep, which the specification cites, each with its codes as the standard writes them at a pinned commit, or at a version its keeper publishes outside git.

name.description: The list's name as the specification writes it, such as `List: API Frameworks` or `Line.frequencyinterval`.

standard.description: The standard that keeps the list, with its version.

url.description: The list in the standard, at a pinned commit; or, for a list its keeper publishes outside git, the `https` URL of the file the keeper publishes, with the list's `version` and the file's `sha256`.

version.description: The version the keeper gives the list, such as ISO 4217's publication date or the IANA database's release, for a list published outside git.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file the URL served at `version`, 64 lowercase hex digits.

copy.description: The repository's copy of the file the URL served at `version`, under `kernel/sources/`, for a URL that serves only the keeper's latest version, so `sha256` stays verifiable. The kernel gate checks that the copy's SHA-256 is `sha256` and, for ISO 4217's List One, that it publishes `version` and holds exactly the list's codes and labels.

vendor.description: The codes the list reserves for vendors, each code from `from` up, as AdCOM 1.0 writes "500+ Vendor-specific codes".

code.description: The code as the standard writes it: an integer, a word, or a name of words joined by `/`, `_`, `+`, or `-`, as an IANA zone name is.

label.description: The standard's name for the code.
